deploy-bot: 🚨 Automated hold triggered: Incident INC-2026-432 in us-east1 (DB failover). Pausing all scheduled releases until ops sign-off.
Devon: saw this. holding all PRNs scheduled today. @Mike (oncall) can you confirm lift criteria?
Mike (oncall): checking replica lag and error rates now — lag is spiking, not safe for additional canaries.
Priya: ok — proposal: keep already-running canaries but cancel any new rollout windows for the next 4h. reschedule the bulk window to 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC. also pin control-plane to v1.12.3 to avoid drift.
Alex: +1 to pin. for releases already in progress: freeze/quiesce traffic rather than rollback unless we see >5% errors or sustained 5xx spike.
Sara: freeze in-flight canaries, monitor closely. rollback only if error budget breach.
Devon: i'll update release notes & changelog to mention incident and new schedule, and prepare a rollback playbook in case we need it.
Priya: @deploy-bot can you apply a hold and tag the affected releases with the incident id? command: `/deploy hold --selector tag=release-window-2026-03-20`
deploy-bot: Hold applied to 18 releases. Annotated with tag `incident/INC-2026-432`. Auto-resume disabled. Use `deploy-bot resume --manual` after ops signoff.
Mike (oncall): ops signoff criteria: replica lag <200ms and error rate stable for 30m. i'll recheck in 15m and post an update.
Alex: i've tentatively scheduled the rescheduled window in the calendar for 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC — cc @PMs for release note timing.
Sara: noted. if we need to push further we'll reopen thread. :thumbsup:
